sessionCapture.note: 6D keeps separate per-series archives, stable finish protection, and generation-based identity for repeated generic RACE sessions.

roleClassification.note: 7C.3 synchronizes restored archive classification with scoring. Explicit restored SDK roles can score; generic RACE remains unclassified and blocked.

scoring.note: 7B totals only canonical sessions captured by this running bridge process. A PowerShell restart does not reconstruct earlier missed sessions.
